title: MECH-05 frozen K-representation selection rule
purpose: Generate a conservative, falsifiable choice among diag, full_or_block, none_or_muon_sufficient, and uncertain without new training.

discovery_scope.heldout_source: MECH-03 endpoint formal layer-scope cross-fit shadow loss
discovery_scope.gpt_bridge_role: runtime robustness only; excluded from discovery decisions

unread_confirmation_sets.name: MECH-06-L1B diagnostic artifacts
unread_confirmation_sets.status: not generated or read at freeze time
unread_confirmation_sets.confirmation_type: prospective for diagnostic-rule outputs only; existing 1B training rankings remain retrospective

threshold_rationale.relative_shadow_loss_margin_and_consiste: Inherited unchanged from the frozen MECH-03 primary gate: 1e-6, 24/32 cells, and 3/4 material layers.
threshold_rationale.diagonal_anisotropy: p95/p05 >= 1.5 is a conservative non-scalar screen; <= 1.25 defines scalar-like behavior, leaving an explicit dead band.
threshold_rationale.repeat_stability: median diagonal cosine >= 0.95 and covariance relative drift <= 0.25 require close repeat agreement before geometry can vote.
threshold_rationale.non_diagonal_subspace: median top-eigenspace overlap >= 0.5 requires majority overlap rather than merely nonzero overlap.
threshold_rationale.longrun_practical_loss: 0.002 is the project-level practical loss margin already used before MECH-05; it is not fitted from LLaMA-1B.

decision_rule.diag: Require stable diagonal anisotropy, a stable positive held-out diag-over-none advantage, and no material long-run contradiction.
decision_rule.full_or_block: Require stable non-diagonal subspace evidence, a stable positive held-out full/block-over-diag advantage, and no material long-run contradiction.
decision_rule.none_or_muon_sufficient: Require scalar-like geometry OR no stable held-out complexity gain together with no K candidate beating none by the long-run practical margin.
decision_rule.uncertain: Return uncertain whenever signals conflict or none of the preceding rules is fully satisfied.
